description: ElectriCité - réseau public de bornes de recharge pour - Seine Aval is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Violette Ficheur. ElectriCité Seine Aval is a public electric charging network for plug-in electric and hybrid vehicles. This network, which will be made up by 2016 of more than 50 terminals, extends over the territory of Seine Aval, north of the Yvelines (78). Coverage: Violette Ficheur. The portal shows the English title as "ElectriCité - public network of charging stations for electric vehicles - Seine Aval" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Violette Ficheur. Its keywords include bornes-de-recharge, infrastructure-de-recharge, irve. The listing shows 2016-03-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
